process.headline: Our Design Process
process.subtitle: Research-Driven, User-Validated
process.description: A design thinking methodology that starts with empathy, iterates through prototyping, and validates through real user feedback at every stage.

steps.title: Discover & Empathize
steps.description: We immerse ourselves in your users world through interviews, observation, and data analysis to deeply understand their needs.
details: Stakeholder workshops to align on business goals and constraints
User research sessions including interviews and contextual inquiry
Analytics review and existing experience audit

steps.title: Define & Architect
steps.description: We synthesize research into actionable insights, define the information architecture, and map out user journeys.
details: Insight synthesis with affinity mapping and journey maps
Information architecture with site maps and content models

steps.title: Design & Prototype
steps.description: We create wireframes, visual designs, and interactive prototypes that bring the product vision to life.
details: Wireframes progressing from low to high fidelity
Visual design with brand-aligned UI components
Interactive prototypes with realistic interactions and flows

steps.title: Test & Validate
steps.description: We test designs with real users, gather feedback, and iterate until usability metrics meet our quality benchmarks.
details: Moderated usability testing with think-aloud protocols
Task success rate and time-on-task measurement
Iterative design refinement based on testing insights

steps.title: Handoff & Support
steps.description: We deliver production-ready designs with detailed specifications and support your development team through implementation.
details: Developer-ready design specs with redlines and assets
Design system documentation and component guidelines
Implementation support and design QA during development

portfolio.headline: Design Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Experiences That Make an Impact
portfolio.description: See how our design work has transformed digital products and delivered measurable business results.

items.title: Healthcare Patient Portal Redesign
items.challenge: A healthcare provider patient portal had a 23% task completion rate and generated 400+ support calls weekly due to confusing navigation and outdated interface.
items.solution: We conducted extensive user research with patients and staff, redesigned the entire experience with simplified navigation, clear visual hierarchy, and WCAG AA accessibility compliance.
results: Task completion rate increased from 23% to 89%
Support calls reduced by 67% within the first month
Patient satisfaction scores improved from 2.1 to 4.6 out of 5

items.title: Fintech Mobile Banking App
items.challenge: A digital bank needed a mobile app that could compete with established banking apps while serving an underbanked demographic with varying levels of digital literacy.
items.solution: We designed an inclusive mobile experience with progressive disclosure, plain language, contextual help, and a simplified transaction flow tested with 50+ users across literacy levels.
results: App store rating of 4.8 stars within three months of launch

items.title: Enterprise SaaS Dashboard
items.challenge: A data analytics SaaS product had a steep learning curve with an average time-to-value of 6 weeks, causing 40% of trial users to churn before seeing results.
items.solution: We redesigned the dashboard with guided onboarding, progressive feature revelation, customizable widgets, and contextual tooltips. We also built a comprehensive design system with 120+ components.
results: Time-to-value reduced from 6 weeks to 3 days
Trial-to-paid conversion rate increased from 12% to 34%
Feature adoption across the product increased by 85%

faq.headline: UI/UX Design FAQ
faq.subtitle: Design Questions Answered
faq.description: Common questions about our design process, deliverables, and how we collaborate with your team.

items.question: What is the difference between UI and UX design?
items.answer: UX design focuses on the overall experience, including research, information architecture, and interaction flows. UI design focuses on the visual presentation, including colors, typography, icons, and layout. We provide both as an integrated service because great products require both to work in harmony.

items.question: How long does a typical design project take?
items.answer: A focused UX audit takes 2-3 weeks. A full product design from research to handoff typically takes 8-16 weeks depending on complexity. Design system projects range from 6-12 weeks. We work in weekly sprints with regular check-ins so you can track progress throughout.

items.question: Do you conduct user research for every project?
items.answer: Yes, some level of user research is part of every engagement. For smaller projects, this might be a heuristic evaluation and stakeholder interviews. For larger projects, we conduct full user research including interviews, surveys, usability testing, and analytics analysis.

items.question: What design tools do you use?
items.answer: We primarily use Figma for UI design, prototyping, and design systems due to its collaborative features. We also use Adobe XD, Sketch, and Framer depending on project needs. All deliverables are provided in formats your development team can easily work with.

items.question: How do you hand off designs to developers?
items.answer: We provide comprehensive handoff packages including annotated designs with specifications, exported assets in all required formats, interactive prototypes, and design system documentation. We also remain available during development to answer questions and review implementation.

items.question: Do you build design systems?
items.answer: Yes, design systems are one of our core offerings. We create comprehensive component libraries with usage guidelines, design tokens, accessibility documentation, and coded component references. Design systems ensure consistency as your product and team scale.

items.question: How do you collaborate with our existing team?
items.answer: We integrate seamlessly with your team through shared Figma workspaces, regular design reviews, and asynchronous feedback loops. We can work alongside your in-house designers or serve as your dedicated design team, adapting to your preferred communication tools and workflows.

items.question: Can you redesign an existing product without starting from scratch?
items.answer: Absolutely. We often do iterative redesigns that improve the experience progressively. We start with a UX audit to identify the highest-impact improvements, then redesign in phases so your users can adapt gradually and you can measure the impact of each change.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing design support after the project?
items.answer: Yes, we offer flexible retainer arrangements for ongoing design needs including new feature design, design QA during development, usability testing, and design system maintenance. This ensures your product continues to evolve with consistent quality.
